items.title: Trinidad and Tobago in talks with ONGC Videsh, Oil India to refine Venezuelan crude
items.summary: The Caribbean government has proposed that the two Indian oil companies process crude from neighbouring Venezuela at the Guaracara refinery in Pointe-à-Pierre, which forms part of the former Petrotrin complex and is currently under renovation.

items.title: iPhone Duo internal display break: Are iPhone Duo displays too fragile? Users report alarming cracks near hinge
items.summary: Users have begun reporting instances of broken inner displays in the new iPhone Duo model. Cracks are appearing near the hinge, causing concern about the device's durability. Some owners experienced damage after minimal use, with one individual reporting a crack after just six hours. Apple is currently analyzing reported cases to determine whether there is a manufacturing issue involved.

items.title: US Markets Today: Dow ends 600 pts lower as AI doubts persist ahead of Fed meet
items.summary: US stocks ended lower after a turbulent week as fresh doubts over the AI trade weighed on sentiment. The Dow fell 1.25%, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also declined. Investors turned their focus to major earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon, along with next week’s Federal Reserve meeting.

items.title: IRDAI to examine LIC agents’ demands as LIAFI opposes key distribution reforms ahead of October 25 deadline
items.summary: With the feedback window closing on October 25, the coming days will show how far IRDAI is willing to adjust commission levels, disclosure rules, and clawback provisions to address LIC agents’ livelihood concerns.

items.title: Tata Motors CV posts Rs 2,138 crore Q2 profit
items.summary: Tata Motors Ltd achieved a standalone net profit of ₹2,138 crore for the September quarter, reversing last year's loss. Revenue from operations rose significantly to ₹23,930 crore, up 42% from the previous year. Improved demand was driven by higher fleet utilization and industrial activity, according to managing director Girish Wagh. Consolidated profit also increased to ₹1,257 crore, aided by a drop in…

items.title: Godrej Properties' Q2FY27 results: Net profit falls 62% to ₹154 crore
items.summary: Record first-half bookings and higher cash collections offset weak quarterly earnings, as total income rises 38% year-on-year

items.title: Commerce minister Piyush Goyal discusses investment avenues with German companies
items.summary: Piyush Goyal engaged with major German firms like Siemens Healthineers, Bayer, and Fresenius to discuss investments. He highlighted Bayer's plans for expansion and collaboration in India's healthcare ecosystem. Goyal also addressed opportunities for Fresenius to leverage India's talent for healthcare solutions. Furthermore, he explored ways to strengthen Siemens Healthineers' presence in the country. These…

items.title: Private sector activity hits four month high in October
items.summary: India's private sector activity experienced significant growth in October, reaching a four-month high as new orders increased. The HSBC Flash India Composite Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.7, signaling expansion. Manufacturing output and new orders remained stable, while services activity saw notable improvement. Employment increased slightly, although firms showed caution in hiring due to adequate staffing…

items.title: US data centre spending seen more than doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028, estimates BoFA
items.summary: Global data centre spending is expected to reach $1 trillion in 2026 and more than double to $2.1 trillion by 2028, driven by rising demand for AI services, BofA Global Research estimates. The data centre market could reach $2.93 trillion by 2030 as AI fuels rapid infrastructure expansion.

items.title: Mother of all IPOs! Jio Platforms shatters many existing records - Full list here
items.summary: Jio Platforms’ ₹30,188-crore IPO became India’s largest, drawing bids of ₹4.72 lakh crore and more than 13.8 million applications. Strong demand across retail and institutional investors set records, with the company valued at up to ₹10.3 lakh crore ahead of its stock market debut.

items.title: Periodic Labour Force Survey to expand coverage to capture unpaid household, volunteers from January 2027
items.summary: From January 2027, the Periodic Labour Force Survey will include unpaid household activities and digital platform workers. New questions will identify individuals engaged in caregiving and relevant unpaid volunteer work in both urban and rural settings. This expansion aims to enhance the measurement of labour-market data. The survey will enable better reporting and data collection on these aspects annually.

items.title: Dr Reddy’s launches two new semaglutide brands amid Obeda supply disruptions
items.summary: The drugmaker has shifted production to a partner facility and expects to resolve the impurity issue affecting its injectable product next month.

items.title: WazirX shifts focus to recovery, AI after year of rebuilding: Shetty
items.summary: A year after restarting operations, WazirX is focusing on recovering value for customers and creditors, rebuilding trust and using AI tools to improve trading outcomes.

items.title: Sebi mulls automatic approval for investments, activities by exchanges
items.summary: Sebi has proposed an automatic approval route for certain activities and investments by market infrastructure institutions, subject to financial limits and governance safeguards.

items.summary: An industry association has sought urgent clarification from the government as the tariff dispute raises concerns over market access and investment

items.title: India to remain strict on quality: Industry minister Piyush Goyal
items.summary: India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal emphasised a strict stance on quality and environmental regulations. He noted that many companies are eager to invest in India across various sectors. Goyal mentioned India's advantages in decarbonisation amidst competition from Europe’s carbon border adjustment mechanism. Discussions on free trade agreements indicate significant potential for job creation in India.

The IT firm had posted a net profit of Rs 375.8 crore in the same period a year ago. items.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
items.summary: India is expanding its domestic tunnel boring machine (TBM) manufacturing capabilities as construction advances on the 125-km Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line.

items.summary: Market regulator Sebi on Friday eased the mandatory requirement for research analysts to maintain call recordings of their interactions with institutional investors to reduce compliance burden and improve ease of doing business. items.title: Tata Sons listing row: What Parsi, Zoroastrian groups want PM Modi to protect
items.summary: The community organisations' letter adds another dimension to the debate, framing the issue as one involving not only corporate governance and regulatory requirements but also the Tata Group's institutional identity and philanthropic commitments.

items.summary: Godrej Properties has lined up project launches worth over ₹32,000 crore for H2 FY27, even as its Q2 net profit fell 62% YoY to ₹154 crore, while cash collections rose 31%

items.title: American Express layoffs: 78,000 employees in firm; the move will affect about 3,500 jobs - here's what AmEx plans to do
items.summary: American Express plans to cut about 3,500 jobs, roughly 5% of its global workforce, as it seeks to streamline operations and improve efficiency. The announcement came alongside stronger third-quarter results and an upgraded 2026 earnings forecast.

items.title: Bajaj General Insurance appoints former Manappuram head Deepak Reddy as CEO-designate
items.summary: Bajaj General Insurance has named Deepak Reddy, former CEO of Manappuram Finance, as CEO-designate from 1 January 2027, subject to regulatory approval.

items.title: US Treasury yields rise but 10-year stays below 5% as AI jitters persist
items.summary: US Treasury yields rise after a sharp drop in the previous session, but the benchmark 10 year yield stays below 5% as lingering AI market concerns keep investors cautious. Strong economic activity and sticky inflation remain key factors for bond markets, while expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week weaken further.

items.title: IPO Subscription status comparison: Reliance Jio IPO vs Hyundai IPO vs NSE IPO - Who won the race?
items.summary: Reliance Jio Platforms’ IPO closed with 22.19 times subscription, led by strong institutional demand at 70.55 times. It is set to surpass Hyundai Motor India’s 2024 IPO as India’s biggest-ever offering.
